title: [Release governance][SongCore #172] Ratify S1 authority, resolve three differentials, E14/docs-verify and AGENTS gate routing
body:
## Owner release-governance follow-up for #172 (S1/S2/S3 → G4)
The S1 FINALIZED contract and Windows RC infrastructure were merged as #327 (`742abf87...`), with **RELEASE_BLOCKED**; source file `docs/release/songcore-release-contract.md` currently expressly says "NOT owner-ratified repository authority". Owner will ratify it only through the documented AGENTS authority process, **not by an issue comment silently changing its class**. This issue tracks the small release-governance delta, separate from the 8-member path leak / L1-L3 experiments in #329.

### Bounded work lanes (separate PRs when useful)
1. **S1 authority ratification delta:** verify the full 822-line finalized contract against current #172/#173, apply an explicitly reviewed update to header/truth-class/router/registry as appropriate. Owner adopts only earned G0–G3/RC rules; §14 unresolved Q1 release version, Q4 Linux glibc symbol floor, Q5 publisher mechanism cannot be silently answered. Keep current unratified marker until merge of explicit authority PR.
2. **Three source/contract differentials:** independently record and decide (a) `song_open` header phrase vs implementation: on failure output pointer set NULL first; (b) contract `files{}` wording vs actual package/matcher semantics; (c) `nulldst + capacity=0` dual-invalid call leaves `produced` unchanged. Classify each as code bug, spec ambiguity or acceptable implementation within contract. Do **not** fix code just to satisfy prose and do not amend normative ABI without owner review and precise counterfactual.
3. **Docs gate completion:** `lefthook.yml` docs-verify (`website/scripts/verify.mjs` and VitePress build) was **NOT_RUN** on Windows local pre-push because piped release-policy stopped first. Run it explicitly on a suitable supported host after `npm ci`, capturing both exit codes, provenance and website checks. Report whether any genuine docs defect exists. CI Release PASS does **not** substitute for website docs verification.
4. **E14-real-ELF host differential:** `tools/test_release.py` E14 assumes host gcc emits ELF; on native Windows gcc emitted pe-x86-64, so local release-policy is deterministically RED. Preserve Linux ubuntu-24.04 CI success for E01–E18 as platform-specific evidence; choose and implement one explicit solution: host-independent adversarial fixture (with declared ELF producer/toolchain) OR documented CI-only release-policy scope with tested local dispatch. Do not use PATH hacks/LEFTHOOK=0 as an undocumented permanent fix.
5. **AGENTS.md gate checklist:** add truthful routing for `release-policy` and any host-conditional gate selection; do not mark NOT_RUN gates PASS. Update derived documentation and self-tests as appropriate, including triggers.
6. **RC/package wording P3:** `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt` stale "NOT granted" phrasing and packaging `external-consumer-example.c` Windows-specific link-line are prior release-readiness documentation issues. Fix by evidence-backed wording before formal G4, with licensing review.

### Boundaries and exit
No `songcore-v*` tag or GitHub Release; no release maturity promotion by doc edits. No changes to Windows/Linux compiled semantics unless the separate differential has an authorized fix PR. Full release remains blocked by #329 T4/L1/L2/L3 and #172's G4. Preserve historical RC SHA256 `7b4d0615d25af464739373a0a3565f77f3208ce9c263f59e578d443801536415` unchanged.

Done when: independent review APPROVE, all authority edits explicit, docs-verify real PASS or labelled BLOCKED, E14 governance resolved, AGENTS coverage true, and individual differentials dispositioned without hidden semantic promotion.

Refs #172, #173, #326, #327, #328, #329.
